description: This Java source file defines a test execution listener class named SkipBaseSetupAnnotationExecutionListener which extends AbstractTestExecutionListener. The class intercepts test method execution to check for the presence of the @SkipBaseSetup annotation and conditionally skips setup actions for certain tests within the OpenMRS testing framework.

classes.name: SkipBaseSetupAnnotationExecutionListener
classes.description: A test execution listener that skips database setup steps when the @SkipBaseSetup annotation is present on test methods or classes in the OpenMRS testing framework.

methods.name: beforeTestMethod
methods.description: A method called before each test method execution, which checks for the @SkipBaseSetup annotation and invokes skipBaseSetup() if present.

methods.name: callMethod
methods.description: A helper method that uses reflection to invoke a specified method with no parameters on the current test class instance.
